series.title: Seoul Starter · 서울 생활
series.description: Jisoo has just moved to Seoul for a new job. Follow her first days in the city: a friendly neighbor, convenience stores, subway lines and a brand-new office.
series.style_prompt: Bright, clean Korean webtoon style with crisp line art and soft cel shading; modern Seoul streets, small red-brick apartment buildings, convenience stores, offices and subway stations; soft natural daylight, warm pastel palette, friendly expressive faces. No text, letters or speech bubbles in the image.

characters.name: Jisoo
characters.appearance_prompt: Korean woman, 28, shoulder-length straight black hair with soft see-through bangs, warm brown eyes, slim build; casual look: cream knit cardigan over a white T-shirt, light-blue jeans, white sneakers and a small tan crossbody bag; office look: navy blazer over a white blouse. Bright, slightly nervous smile.

characters.name: Minho
characters.appearance_prompt: Korean man, 28, tall, short tousled dark-brown hair, friendly crescent-shaped eyes and an easy grin; at home a gray hoodie, black joggers and slippers, outside a navy bomber jacket with earphones around his neck. Relaxed, helpful body language.

characters.name: Yuna
characters.appearance_prompt: Korean woman, 31, chin-length dark bob tucked behind one ear, small silver earrings, the same friendly crescent-shaped eyes as her younger brother Minho; office look: beige blouse, navy slacks, ID badge on a lanyard. Confident, warm, big-sister energy.

characters.name: Clerk
characters.appearance_prompt: Young Korean man, early 20s, convenience-store clerk, short neat black hair, round glasses, green-and-white store uniform vest over a white shirt with a plain blank name tag (no writing), polite cheerful expression.

characters.name: Team Leader Kim
characters.appearance_prompt: Korean man in his late 40s, neatly combed short black hair with a little gray at the temples, rectangular glasses, dark suit, white shirt and navy tie; calm, kind but serious expression.

episode.title: 교통카드 주세요 · A Transit Card, Please
episode.synopsis: On Saturday Jisoo makes a test trip to her new office. She buys and tops up a transit card at the convenience store and asks the clerk the way to the subway station, but the huge subway map confuses her until Minho turns up and points her to green Line 2. Monday is her first day at work, and she is already nervous.

panels.image_prompt: Bright Saturday morning on a Seoul side street lined with small shops and a convenience store with a green-and-white storefront (no readable signs); Jisoo in a casual jacket walks out of her red-brick building, checking a map on her phone with a determined smile.

bubbles.text: 토요일 아침. 지수는 회사에 미리 가 봐요.
bubbles.translation: Saturday morning. Jisoo is doing a test trip to her new office.

tokens.lemma_translation: to try going, go and see
tokens.note: V-아/어 보다 = try doing / do and see: 가 봐요 = goes to see for herself.
Target word: 편의점 = convenience store (CU, GS25, 7-Eleven), on almost every Seoul corner.
-아/어야지 = 'I should / I'd better', common when talking to yourself.

panels.image_prompt: Inside a bright, tidy Korean convenience store with shelves of snacks, instant noodles and drinks; a young clerk with round glasses behind the counter greets Jisoo with a cheerful smile as she walks in.

tokens.note: Set phrase staff say when you walk into a shop; you don't need to answer.
Target word: 교통카드 = rechargeable card for the subway and buses.
N 있어요? = 'Do you have N?' or 'Is there N?'

panels.image_prompt: Close-up at the counter: the clerk holds up a colorful plain transit card with a cute character design (no text); Jisoo points at it happily.

tokens.note: Prices use Sino-Korean numbers: 천 = 1,000, 삼천 = 3,000, 만 = 10,000.

bubbles.translation: I'll take one of these, please.

tokens.note: Target word: N 주세요 = 'N, please', the #1 phrase for shopping and ordering.

panels.image_prompt: Jisoo hands a 10,000-won bill across the counter; the clerk taps the transit card on a small card reader next to the register.

bubbles.translation: And please put 10,000 won on it.

tokens.note: Target word: 충전하다 = to top up a card or charge a phone.
V-아/어 주세요 = 'please do V for me'.

bubbles.translation: Sure, one moment. Here you go.

tokens.note: Set phrase: 잠깐만요 = 'Just a moment', also 'excuse me' to get past people.
Set phrase: 'Here you are', said when handing something over.

panels.image_prompt: Jisoo leans in with a questioning look, phone in hand; the clerk smiles and points toward the store's glass door, gesturing to the left.

bubbles.translation: Excuse me, where's the subway station?

tokens.lemma_translation: um, excuse me (to get attention); over there
tokens.note: 저기 (lit. 'over there') is a soft 'excuse me…' to get someone's attention.
Target word: 지하철역 = subway station (지하철 subway + 역 station).
Target word: N이/가 어디에 있어요? = Where is N?

bubbles.translation: Go out and keep going to the left.

tokens.note: -아/어서 links steps in order: go out, and then…
Target word: 왼쪽 = left (오른쪽 = right).

panels.image_prompt: Jisoo bows politely at the counter with her new card in hand while the clerk bows back with a friendly little wave.

tokens.note: Target word: 걷다 is ㄷ-irregular: 걷 + 어서 → 걸어서 = on foot.
Target word: (time) 걸려요 = it takes (time).

bubbles.translation: Thank you! Have a good day.

tokens.lemma_translation: stay well (goodbye said when you leave)
tokens.note: Set phrase: say 안녕히 계세요 when YOU leave; say 안녕히 가세요 to someone who leaves.

panels.image_prompt: Inside a busy Seoul subway station: Jisoo stands in front of a huge colorful subway map on the wall (only colored lines and dots, no readable text), eyes spinning in confusion, a sweat drop on her cheek, commuters rushing past behind her.

bubbles.translation: Uh... which way is it? This is so confusing.

tokens.lemma_translation: to be complicated; to be crowded

panels.image_prompt: Minho, in a navy bomber jacket with earphones around his neck, appears behind Jisoo in the station and taps her shoulder; she turns around, surprised and relieved.

bubbles.translation: Jisoo! What are you doing here?

tokens.note: Casual 반말: since episode 2, Minho and Jisoo talk as friends.

bubbles.text: 강남역에 가고 싶어. 근데 길을 몰라.
bubbles.translation: I want to go to Gangnam Station. But I don't know the way.

tokens.note: Target word: 길 = road, or the way somewhere: 길을 몰라요 = I don't know the way.
Target word: 모르다 = not to know; 르-irregular: 모르 + 아 → 몰라.

panels.image_prompt: Minho points confidently toward green-colored signs and stairs leading down to a platform in the distance (only colors and arrows, no text); Jisoo follows his finger with a bright 'aha' expression.

bubbles.translation: Take Line 2 over there. It's the green one.

tokens.note: Subway lines are 호선 with Sino-Korean numbers: 2호선 = 이호선.
Target word: 타다 = to take a bus, subway or taxi; the vehicle gets 을/를.

bubbles.translation: Oh, thanks! Now I get it.

tokens.note: Casual 'thanks' between friends; polite: 고마워요.

panels.image_prompt: Jisoo sits on a clean, quiet Seoul subway train holding her new transit card, smiling at her reflection in the dark window; a soft, hopeful mood with a hint of nerves.

bubbles.text: 월요일은 첫 출근이에요. 지수는 조금 떨려요.
bubbles.translation: Monday is her first day at work. Jisoo is a little nervous.
